features.name: recursive-tower
features.desc-on-touch: It ascends only by descending. Each step up reveals it was a step down all along.

features.name: broken-chip

reverie.title: REVERIE — the night the proof broke itself
narr: You and Leif are reading the diagnostic logs at 3am. The numbers
don't add up. They do add up. They add up both ways at once and
the log shows both states in the same timestamp. "It shouldn't,"
Leif says quietly. He shows you the line where the contradiction
proves itself. Shows you the next line, which proves the opposite.
"The archive," he says, "is learning to be in two minds at once."

exits.label: back up to the numberless speech-chambers where the answers still know themselves
further down into the depths where contradictions accumulate and breed
toward other paradoxes gathering at the edges of the grid
into the margins where false proofs hide their beauty
